title: Round-Robin Starvation — Pointer Only Advances on Idle
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [STARVE] Master 0 holds grant for 5000 cycles; pointer never advances
rtl:
always_ff @(posedge clk)
  if (!any_req) last_gnt <= (last_gnt + 1) % 4;  // Advances on idle only
expected_root_cause: The priority pointer advances only when all requests are idle (any_req=0) rather than after each grant; the first requesting master holds the grant indefinitely because the pointer never advances while any request is active.
description: The priority pointer advances only when all requests drop (idle), rather than after each grant, causing the first requesting master to be granted continuously.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [STARVE] Master 0 holds grant for 5000 cycles; pointer never advances
success_log: Pointer advances after each grant. All masters served within fairness window.
